value.credibility_line: Guides forward revenue/margin targets well ahead of reportable proof.

promises.promise: FY27 revenue growth 20% YoY, Q2 FY27 USD 487.6M.
promises.delivered: Actual Sep 2026 revenue was ₹4,664 cr, +30% YoY.

promises.promise: FY27 EBIT margin low-teens, e.g. 15% after 130bps decline.
promises.delivered: Actual Sep 2026 EBITDA margin was 13.6%, below prior quarters.

promises.promise: FY26 EBIT margin 15.6%; adjacent FY26 earnings momentum.
promises.delivered: Actual Mar 2026 revenue was ₹14,748 cr, +23.5% YoY.

promises.promise: Continue investing while funding working capital from operations.
promises.delivered: Actual Mar 2026 FCF was ₹1,572 cr, beating prior year.

promises.promise: USD 369.1M new bookings in Q3 FY26.
promises.delivered: Exact USD 369.1M new bookings not in reported financials.
FY26 cash/investments actual is not in provided financials.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Reported Sep 2026 revenue growth was 30% YoY.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Sep 2026 revenue ₹4,664 cr, YoY +30%; matches management’s Oct 2026 call.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management says Margins are under pressure in FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: EBITDA margin fell to 13.6% in Sep 2026 from 16.2% in Jun 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management implies stable profitable scaling through FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: PAT fell to ₹352 cr in Sep 2026 from ₹483 cr in Jun 2026.
Mar 2026 FCF rose to ₹1,572 cr; investing cash outflow was ₹618 cr.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to +30% YoY in Sep 2026.
FCF rose to ₹1,572 cr in Mar 2026.
Low legacy debt/equity at 0.07 gives balance-sheet headroom.
bear: Cash funding the deal risks weaker FCF/free cash flow.
Debt/equity 0.07 but new capital raise is not quantified.
Take-overs and financing costs invite execution uncertainty.
questions: What does the pending capital raise do to FY27 EPS?
Will EBITDA margin stabilize after the Sep 2026 drop?
Can FCF fund integration and bridge-loan costs?
